purpose: Correct the Stage-5 corridor topology while retaining low-density corridor behavior needed for deployment.
authorization_limit: This protocol authorizes SA5-R2 training and checkpoint creation only; it cannot accept an SA5 parent or launch SA6.
declared_interventions: seal the 10 m corridor interaction zone to the 15 m Stage-5 room boundary with 0.5 m overlap at both ends
replace the 3S2D/4S2D-only corridor reset distribution with the preregistered low-density mix
attribution_limit: Any difference from the legacy lineage is jointly attributable to corrected geometry and corridor-density coverage; this run cannot isolate either intervention by itself.

supersedes_before_training.reason: The geometry-only candidate was never formally started and did not include the requested low-density corridor coverage.
supersedes_before_training.preservation: Its config, smoke evidence and freeze protocol remain as historical design evidence.

parent.caveat: The parent has earlier exposure to legacy unsealed corridor replay; this is a warm-start correction, not a from-scratch clean baseline.

training.rationale: Low-density exposure prevents a policy trained only in crowded corridors from learning unnecessary stop-and-go behavior when only one moving obstacle is present.

pre_training_baseline_requirement.checkpoint: the exact frozen SA4-R3 conceptual-it125 parent
pre_training_baseline_requirement.purpose: Measure inherited hard-corridor behavior before any SA5-R2 update. This baseline stays fixed even though the training distribution adds low-density cases.
pre_training_baseline_requirement.acceptance_effect: Diagnostic baseline only; it cannot accept or reject the training lineage by itself.

post_training_requirements: screen every saved checkpoint on fixed sealed 4S2D lateral, longitudinal, random-2d and mixed stress cells
test low-density sealed 0S1D and 1S1D cells for SR, CR, TO, speed and unnecessary stopping
verify native and narrow retention for the leading checkpoints
do not select a parent from training metrics alone
